trust: November ground photos of the big-pool lawn and the steps to Enrique's. Lines are estimated from the camera pins and headings, good to about 4 m; widths and heights are read by eye. The glass fence those photos show is left out (Dave, 2026-10-11, confirmed 2026-11-12).

fittings.name: Bollard lights, slatted bins and slot drains on the main-pool lawn
fittings.note: Bins and bollards stand where IMG_2764 and IMG_2603 put them along the path (nearest bollard about 3 m from the camera on the right, a bin with a bollard on the right at about 7-9 m, bollards on the left further on, a bollard and a bin by the palm at the pool end), placed by distance along the path and side, moved with the path onto the aerial strip (2026-11-13). The gate pair (IMG_2759, IMG_2761) stays by the gate. The square grey service lid (IMG_2761, whose pin falls on the aerial path) is about 3.5 m east of the path; IMG_2760 and IMG_2759 show one or two more lids their pins cannot place.

rooms.name: White walls, door and strelitzia bed on the main-pool lawn
rooms.note: 2026-11-13: the strelitzia and silver bush stood inside the kiosk's registry footprint (6364501UF1366S_part2, which matches its white roof on the aerial); IMG_2762, whose camera looks straight at the kiosk's north corner, shows them in front of it on the lawn, so they are moved just outside that corner.

hedge.name: Shower on the sea side of the main-pool lawn (the hedge along the railing is in the ground plan)
hedge.note: 2026-11-14: the hedge moved to data/ground_plan_main_pool.json as the main lawn's edge along the whole sea railing; the shower stays here.

plainBuildings.name: Plain white kiosk at the lawn's sea corner
plainBuildings.note: IMG_2759 (the white block right of the beach gateway), IMG_2762 (white walls with louvred service doors and the strelitzia corner) and IMG_2763 (a round plain white wall) show this registry building as plain white walls with no shutters, balconies, arched doors or tiled porch roofs; the generic facade dressing is left off it (2026-11-13). Its louvred doors and flat roof are not modelled.
